lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'm Burningum, the Deputy Chief.
What's the problem this time?
What is going on?
Burningum remains silent for a moment.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Let me tell you something.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I may not be your direct superior, but I'm still a Deputy Chief.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I should be treated with respect.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hasn't Andersen taught you any manners?
This has nothing to do with him.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I heard you and Cervan have been seeing a lot of each other?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: He's my son,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: and has gone missing.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: My assistant said there is a record of him using the elevator yesterday.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I fear that he's gone up to the surface by himself.
Are you asking me to go save him?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Regardless of how brave he is and how he has graduated from the military academy,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: he's still just a civilian.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: If I want him to be brought back safely, I need someone like you to help me.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: A soldier on active duty.
Don't you have the entire Central Government at your disposal? Why not use them?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I wish I could, but

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: it is prohibited for a civilian to use the elevator.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: For a man in my position, I can't allow any word of this to get out.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You are a soldier as well, so I hope you can understand.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We're running out of time, so we must hurry.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: He's your friend as well. Surely you don't want any harm to befall him?
All right, I'll do it.
